mapper.sql: `id`, `class_code`, `class_name`, `college_id`, `major_id`, (SELECT m.major_name FROM major m WHERE m.id = class_info.major_id) AS major_name, `enrollment_year`, `student_count`, `created_at`, `updated_at`
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.class_code, c.class_name, c.college_id, c.major_id, (SELECT m.major_name FROM major m WHERE m.id = c.major_id) AS major_name, c.enrollment_year, c.student_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM class_info c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM college_admin a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.college_id = c.college_id ) ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT FROM `class_info` ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageQuery.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageQuery.start}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `class_info` (class_code, class_name, college_id, major_id, enrollment_year, student_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{classCode}, #{className}, #{collegeId}, #{majorId}, #{enrollmentYear}, #{studentCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM class_info WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE class_id = #{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_filing WHERE class_id = #{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counselor_class WHERE class_id = #{id})
